thread:
marta: T-minus 3 minutes to the change window. Quick wrist-check: smoke tests, canary plan, rollback gates. Posting RN link: https://internal.releases/redwood/1.4.3

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @marta. Start=2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Strategy=canary: 3% x 8m -> 20% x 12m -> 60% x 10m -> 100%. Pin moving v3.4.2 -> v3.5.0. Pins will be locked during rollout.

alex: Staging smoke passed. Gen p95=120ms, p99=180ms, errors=0.06%. Baseline looks stable.

ashley: Dashboards configured: quick-look widgets + rolling-slo panel. Alerting set: page @oncall-bg if 5xx > 0.4% sustained 4m OR p99 latency > +35% sustained 6m. I'll maintain watch.

marta: Rollback decision matrix reminder: immediate rollback if any of -- 1) 5xx > 0.6% for 3m, 2) p99 increase > 40% for 5m, 3) critical revenue path errors. If triggered, rollback to pinned v3.4.2.

oncall-bg: I'll execute rollback runbook and call incident if needed. Owners: oncall-bg(rollback exec), alex(logs/traces), ashley(monitoring), release-manager(customer comms).

deploy-bot: Canary guard: if canary error-rate > 0.45% for two consecutive windows, pause and alert channel. Auto-rollback for region-wide failures only.

alex: Note: I added a temporary debug gate to reduce noise from kv-cache reconnect WARNs during prefix warmup. If you see a tail on latency, check for kvcache reconnect logs rather than app errors.

marta: Communication plan: release-manager will draft post-rollout email. For rollback we'll send a rollback status note and incident stub.

release-manager: RN highlights: kvcache refactor, embedding perf tweaks, minor reranker fix. No infra migrations. Post-deploy checklist: tag image, emit telemetry checkpoint, update runbooks.

ashley: Locking pins now -> /deploy lock-pins by @ashley
deploy-bot: Pins locked by @ashley. Unpin requires two approvers (release-manager + oncall-bg).

marta: Any last calls? If clear I'll trigger at T0.

alex: :+1:
ashley: ready
release-manager: ready to publish
oncall-bg: standing by

deploy-bot: Rollout started. Phase=canary 3% (8m). Notifying SLO guardrails.

marta: Smoke checklist during canary: /health, sample-chat-check, embedding-sanity set (10 queries).

alex: Canary minute 2: errors 0.05%, p99 185ms. Slight jitter expected during kvcache TTL fill.

ashley: Dashboards show small latency tail on long sequences but no error cluster. Keeping an eye.

oncall-bg: Raising sensitivity on alerts for the next 30m. I'll escalate at first sustained threshold breach.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 20% at +8m automatically. Monitoring windows open.

marta: Watch redis connection counts and kvcache miss ratio. The refactor changes timeouts.

alex: Connection spike on rollout start; warmup completed and counts normalized. No error signs.

release-manager: Drafting customer-facing note in #marketing-drafts; holding until full completion.

marta: If rollback needed preferred command (manual):
```
/deploy rollback --to v3.4.2 --reason "canary breach"
```
I'll ping exec if we escalate.

ashley: Manual unpin command (requires approvals):
```
/deploy unpin v3.5.0 --by @release-manager
```

oncall-bg: If I call rollback, I will run playbook steps and post timestamps. Team will not reattempt deployment until postmortem or explicit clearance.

deploy-bot: Rollout reached 60% then 100%. Final status: success. All regions green. Pins remain locked.

marta: Change window closed. Release-manager publish RN + customer comms. Opening short retro tomorrow for any follow-ups.

release-manager: RN published. Post-deploy ops: image tagged, telemetry checkpoint created, runbook updated.

alex: Follow-up: monitor p99 for 24h; kvcache warm-start tail may cause small regressions.

ashley: I'll add an extended p99 alert and a playbook note for kvcache warmup troubleshooting.

marta: Thanks team, great coordination. :rocket:
